transcript: You're going to die. Why on earth are you worried about all the stuff that you worry about? Think about this. We are standing on a quiet rock, spinning through space, surrounded by a universe so vast, your fears don't even echo inside it. And yet, you let small things disturb your peace. Other people's opinions, fear of failure, trying to control everything, pause. If you knew there was no tomorrow, that tonight was your last night here, would you still stress about work, about being on time, about things that don't even touch your soul? Or would something inside you soften? Would you finally breathe a little deeper? Speak a little more honestly. Care a little less about what doesn't matter. Most people don't live. They postpone living, waiting for the perfect moment, the perfect version of themselves, the perfect conditions that never come. But life is not waiting. So how long will it be before you live? Do not waste your days chasing perfection. Do not waste your energy trying to impress the world. Because in the end, it does not matter how rich you became, how perfect you looked, or how much approval you collected. You can be the richest, most perfect person, and still lie in the same quiet ground as everyone else. So why carry so much when none of it goes with you? Today, choose peace. And finally, live. If this woke something inside you, comment, alive, and follow. I'll remind you what actually matters.
